apple_secure_orchard.purpose: persistent protected APPLE harvest mother producing banked fruit

requirements: at least two walkable home doors
initial natural trees nonempty and all reachable
median natural-tree return distance at least 8
geometry.reason_for_door_cell: HARVEST and DROP occur at the same bank-adjacent cell

requirements: starter empty on a home door
non-starter chopper can use an alternate door with mother blocked
reserving starter does not surrender a non-duplicable contested natural-tree cycle

invariants: mother never an ordinary chop target
exclusive starter ownership while CarryingSeed or Active
other workers cannot consume the reserved seed or occupy the mother
at least one alternate home door remains usable
no current replant loop after mother loss
parent commands exact outside declared orchard intervention

next_candidate.name: PROSPECTIVE_OPPORTUNITY_COST_GATE
next_candidate.V_orchard: guaranteed banked APPLE before turn 300 minus seed and explicit risk deductions
next_candidate.V_displaced: guaranteed banked score plus non-duplicable denial value from the starter task overridden by orchard
required_instrumentation: whether another worker can complete the task
next_candidate.threshold_rule: delta must be frozen before fresh outcomes and must not be fit on the current 1280 games

direct_banana_mother_swap.reason: the protected mother is harvested, not chopped; APPLE is faster beside water and more durable

bounded_banana_wood_orchard.purpose: self-sustained BANANA seed source feeding one disposable wood-production tree

role_split.child: planted on a cut slot and chopped for wood before fruit

tent_neighbor_rule.orthogonal_neighbors: cut/banking cells; chop BANANA for wood

mother_geometry.location: one diagonal cell around the home tent
requirements: not on a required home-door route

cut_slot_geometry.location: one orthogonal side-neighbor of the home tent
requirements: not the unique usable home door
reachable by the wood worker without crossing the mother
no farther from our tent than from the opponent tent

wood_worker: pick only an unreserved BANANA seed
plant only on the cut slot

seed_ledger.source_of_truth: confirmed carry and inventory deltas, not issued commands
rules: do not plant cut slot before mother repays a seed
consume lease only after confirmed PLANT
release harvested seed only after confirmed DROP
mother loss stops new cut cycles

constraints: wood no greater than free carry capacity
opponent cannot control child before planned kill
cut_cycle.fallback: if no safe positive cycle exists, chop immediately or suspend

activation_requirements: valid diagonal mother and orthogonal cut slot
at least one harvest plus cut/fell/drop cycle fits before turn 300
no non-duplicable contested natural-tree cycle is surrendered
no worker-three funding or unrelated crop policy
safety_invariants: exactly one mother and one cut slot
orthogonal child always intended for chop
one owner per tree and slot
wood carrier follows monotone bank commitment
